terms.meaning: You. The Creator stands above the whole cosmos, summons the sons and holds every power over what the world makes.
A god you summon. Each son is a card of a rarity, carries its domains, has essence of its own and takes a turn every epoch.
A god that was in a world before your sons. Foreign gods can sleep and wake, keep worshippers and stand with or against your sons.
All your sons together, with their storylines and rivalries.
What a god stands for. A son's domains decide where its creations cost less and which tools it may use.
The grade of a son's card, from Common to Mythic. A rarer son has more action points and may use more tools.
A son appears as a card of its rarity. On the Cards screen every god, mortal, beast, spirit and being can be seen as a card.
The judge of every epoch. When the turns are over, Fate decides which new records stay as canon and which are rejected, and follows the open stories of the world.
The voice that writes the history of each epoch into the chronicle once Fate has judged.
What is true in the world. A record Fate keeps, or one you place yourself, is canon. You can strike a record from canon or restore it.
A sentence you set down as true about the world. It stays true until you retire it.
An open story Fate follows across epochs until it closes. You can open and close one yourself.
Keeping a record or a value as it is: no step of the engine and no son or mortal may change it until you release it.
Letting a held record or value follow the world again.
Holding one single value of a record so that no mechanic changes it.
Tearing a page out of the action ledger. The world goes back to how it was before that action, and the essence it spent is refunded.
A saved copy of the world, taken before every epoch. A backup can be restored from the settings.
The whole world as one package with its database and images. Another world's package opens read-only beside yours, merges into yours or replaces it.
The start of a new world: its seed, its Creator and the first sons.
The idea a world starts from at genesis. The world follows it into whatever kind of lore it asks for.
A single person of a world, with a body, a mind and a life. Notable mortals take turns of their own.
Anyone who decides for itself each epoch: the sons and the acting mortals and communities. Agents act through tools.
The moment in an epoch when a son or another agent reads its world and acts.
The budget of a turn. Most tools spend one point. A son's points follow the rarity of its card.
One deed a son or a mortal can do in its turn. Every tool runs through the rules of the world. The booklet The Deeds of Sons and Mortals lists them all.
One thing you, as the Creator, can do to the world from a screen of the game: make, change, hold or unmake. The booklet The Powers of a God lists them all.
Anything the world holds by name, from a person or a people to a war, a law or a song. Every record has its own page.
One working of the world that the engine runs. The booklet How the World Connects describes each one and what it reaches.
One of the areas the mechanics are gathered in, such as the body, the mind, society, the economy, faith, war and the cosmos.
The rule-driven simulation that lives the world through every epoch, step by step, by the world rules.
One stage of the world engine within an epoch. The steps run in a fixed order, and each can be switched off or run on its own from the settings.
A gathering of the pantheon that votes on a ruling. The Creator may veto a ruling.
A wish a son or a mortal sends to the Creator, waiting for your answer.
A goal you choose to play toward, with its deadline. Scenarios and the goals you set yourself are weighed into your score and achievements.
The searchable list of every record of the world, by type and family, with each record's page beside it.

entity.meaning: Any record that lives in a world: a person, a people, a place, a creature, an object, an event and every other kind of record below.

son.meaning: A god you summon. A son takes a turn every epoch and acts through its tools.

creator.meaning: You, the player. The Creator has a page of its own, with its mood, its passions and the way the sons and the peoples see it.

foreign_god.meaning: A god that was in a world before your sons.

world.meaning: A planet or a moon. Each world has its own type, regions, peoples, seasons and climate, and a cosmos may hold many worlds.

star.meaning: A star, of a type with its own age and light, that worlds may orbit.

galaxy.meaning: A galaxy of stars, of a type, an age and zones of its own.

dimension.meaning: A dimension beside the ordinary cosmos, with its own kind, causality and elements, reached through rifts.

region.meaning: A broad stretch of land on a world. A region holds places, settlements and peoples, and can hold smaller regions.

place.meaning: A particular spot of land inside a region, with its own danger, fertility and mystery.

resource.meaning: Something of worth the land holds and the peoples can take.

settlement.meaning: A village, town or city where people live.

species.meaning: A kind of living being, with its own body, life and ways.

people.meaning: A community of mortals with a shared culture, language and history.

mortal.meaning: One person, with a body, a mind, a life story and bonds to others.

item.meaning: A made object that someone can hold, carry or keep.

structure.meaning: A building or work raised on the land.

language.meaning: A tongue with its own sounds, words and history. Languages change, split into dialects, mix and die.

legend.meaning: A story a people tells and keeps.

tradition.meaning: A custom a community keeps across generations.

cult.meaning: A body of worshippers devoted to a god.

faction.meaning: An organised group within a world with aims of its own, such as a guild or an order.

celestial.meaning: A body a god hangs in the sky of a world.

artwork.meaning: A work of art made by mortals or gods.

law.meaning: A law decreed for a community or a realm.

spirit.meaning: A being without a mortal body. Spirits can take turns of their own.

knowledge.meaning: Something known that the peoples can learn, teach and lose.

prophecy.meaning: A foretelling that may come true.

event.meaning: Something that happens over seasons and years and leaves its mark, of one of many kinds.

vessel.meaning: A ship or other craft that carries people and goods.

outer_being.meaning: A being from outside the cosmos that comes in as the Outside leaks into a world.

trade_route.meaning: A road of trade between settlements or worlds.

disease.meaning: A sickness that spreads among the living.

polity.meaning: A realm: a state that rules lands and peoples.

house.meaning: A family line of standing, with its members, claims and fortunes.

treaty.meaning: An agreement sealed between realms or communities.

title.meaning: An office or rank that a holder carries and passes on.

ideology.meaning: A body of ideas about how the world should be.

theory.meaning: An explanation the learned put forward about how the world works.

art_form.meaning: A form of art a people practises.

rite.meaning: A ritual act performed by a faith or a community.

beast.meaning: A single great creature with a lair and a will of its own. Beasts can take turns of their own.

phenomenon.meaning: A lasting happening of the heavens, of one of the kinds listed under the kinds of the cosmos.

cosmic_being.meaning: A being on the scale of the cosmos, of one of the kinds listed under the kinds of the cosmos.

vehicle_type.meaning: A design of vehicle that can be built again and again.

unit_type.meaning: A kind of soldier a realm trains and fields.

equipment_model.meaning: A design of equipment that can be made again and again.

dish.meaning: A dish a people cooks and eats.

building_type.meaning: A design of building that settlements raise.

network.meaning: A network that reaches members across lands, settlements and structures. A mind can live in one.

league.meaning: A league of members bound together for a shared aim.

natural_law.meaning: A law of nature a god decrees for the cosmos.
